requirements.quote: Note that a Sender is permitted to send further PUBLISH Packets with different Packet Identifiers while it is waiting to receive acknowledgements.
requirements.condition: While a QoS 1 Sender is waiting for acknowledgements for earlier PUBLISH Packets
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender is permitted to send further PUBLISH Packets using different Packet Identifiers.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple in-flight PUBLISH Packets can be observed before acknowledgements, and their identifiers compared.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBACK Packet containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message
requirements.condition: When the QoS 1 Receiver accepts an incoming PUBLISH Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must respond with PUBACK.
requirements.why_checkable: A QoS 1 PUBLISH can be sent and the response packet type observed.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBACK Packet containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message
requirements.condition: When PUBACK acknowledges an incoming QoS 1 PUBLISH Packet
requirements.required_behavior: PUBACK must contain the Packet Identifier from that PUBLISH Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The request and acknowledgement Packet Identifiers can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBACK Packet containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message
requirements.condition: Before the QoS 1 Receiver sends PUBACK
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must have accepted ownership of the Application Message.
requirements.why_checkable: Receiver state can be instrumented at PUBACK emission to confirm ownership has been accepted.

requirements.quote: After it has sent a PUBACK Packet the Receiver MUST treat any incoming PUBLISH packet that contains the same Packet Identifier as being a new publication, irrespective of the setting of its DUP flag.
requirements.condition: After the Receiver sends PUBACK, when it later receives PUBLISH with the same Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must treat the later PUBLISH as a new publication.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Receiver must not associate it with the already acknowledged publication solely because the identifier is reused.
requirements.why_checkable: A Packet Identifier can be reused after PUBACK and the resulting delivery/state transition observed.

requirements.quote: After it has sent a PUBACK Packet the Receiver MUST treat any incoming PUBLISH packet that contains the same Packet Identifier as being a new publication, irrespective of the setting of its DUP flag.
requirements.condition: After PUBACK, when PUBLISH reuses that Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver's classification as a new publication must be independent of whether DUP is 0 or 1.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Receiver must not use DUP to override the required new-publication classification after PUBACK.
requirements.why_checkable: The same post-PUBACK identifier reuse can be tested once with each DUP value.

requirements.quote: A QoS 2 message has a Packet Identifier in its variable header.
requirements.condition: For every QoS 2 PUBLISH message
requirements.required_behavior: Its variable header must contain a Packet Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: A QoS 2 PUBLISH variable header can be decoded for Packet Identifier presence.

requirements.quote: MUST assign an unused Packet Identifier when it has a new Application Message to publish.
requirements.condition: When a QoS 2 Sender has a new Application Message to publish
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender must assign a Packet Identifier that is unused among its currently in-flight exchanges.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Sender must not assign an identifier already in use.
requirements.why_checkable: The identifiers of concurrent incomplete exchanges can be collected and checked for uniqueness.

requirements.quote: MUST send a PUBLISH packet containing this Packet Identifier with QoS=2, DUP=0.
requirements.condition: When the QoS 2 Sender transmits a new Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender must send a PUBLISH Packet containing the newly assigned Packet Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The assigned identifier and PUBLISH variable-header identifier can be compared.

requirements.quote: MUST send a PUBLISH packet containing this Packet Identifier with QoS=2, DUP=0.
requirements.condition: When initially sending a new QoS 2 Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The PUBLISH Packet must have QoS set to 2.
requirements.why_checkable: The QoS bits can be decoded and compared with value 2.

requirements.quote: MUST send a PUBLISH packet containing this Packet Identifier with QoS=2, DUP=0.
requirements.condition: When initially sending a new QoS 2 Application Message
requirements.required_behavior: The PUBLISH Packet must have DUP set to 0.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The first send must not be marked as a duplicate delivery attempt.
requirements.why_checkable: The DUP bit can be decoded on the first captured PUBLISH transmission.

requirements.quote: MUST treat the PUBLISH packet as “unacknowledged” until it has received the corresponding PUBREC packet from the receiver.
requirements.condition: After sending QoS 2 PUBLISH and before receiving its corresponding PUBREC
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender must keep that PUBLISH in the unacknowledged state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Sender must not mark the PUBLISH acknowledged before corresponding PUBREC arrives.
requirements.why_checkable: Sender state can be inspected while the matching PUBREC is withheld.

requirements.quote: MUST send a PUBREL packet when it receives a PUBREC packet from the receiver.
requirements.condition: When the QoS 2 Sender receives the corresponding PUBREC
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender must send PUBREL.
requirements.why_checkable: A PUBREC can be injected and the next sender packet type observed.

requirements.quote: This PUBREL packet MUST contain the same Packet Identifier as the original PUBLISH packet.
requirements.condition: When PUBREL continues a QoS 2 exchange begun by PUBLISH
requirements.required_behavior: PUBREL must contain the original PUBLISH Packet Identifier.
requirements.why_checkable: The Packet Identifiers of the original PUBLISH and corresponding PUBREL can be compared.

requirements.quote: MUST treat the PUBREL packet as “unacknowledged” until it has received the corresponding PUBCOMP packet from the receiver.
requirements.condition: After sending PUBREL and before receiving its corresponding PUBCOMP
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender must keep that PUBREL in the unacknowledged state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Sender must not mark PUBREL acknowledged before corresponding PUBCOMP arrives.
requirements.why_checkable: Sender state can be inspected while the matching PUBCOMP is withheld.

requirements.quote: MUST NOT re-send the PUBLISH once it has sent the corresponding PUBREL packet.
requirements.condition: After the Sender sends PUBREL for a QoS 2 PUBLISH
requirements.required_behavior: Further retransmission for that stage must use the PUBREL state rather than the original PUBLISH.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Sender must not re-send the corresponding PUBLISH after PUBREL has been sent.
requirements.why_checkable: Acknowledgements can be withheld after PUBREL and later transmissions checked for absence of the original PUBLISH.

requirements.quote: The Packet Identifier becomes available for reuse once the Sender has received the PUBCOMP Packet.
requirements.condition: When the Sender receives the corresponding PUBCOMP
requirements.required_behavior: The QoS 2 exchange's Packet Identifier must become available for reuse.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The identifier must not be considered reusable before corresponding PUBCOMP is received.
requirements.why_checkable: Identifier allocation state can be inspected immediately before and after PUBCOMP reception.

requirements.quote: Note that a Sender is permitted to send further PUBLISH Packets with different Packet Identifiers while it is waiting to receive acknowledgements.
requirements.condition: While a QoS 2 Sender is waiting for acknowledgements for earlier PUBLISH Packets
requirements.required_behavior: The Sender is permitted to send further PUBLISH Packets using different Packet Identifiers.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple QoS 2 exchanges can be observed concurrently and their identifiers compared.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBREC containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message.
requirements.condition: When the QoS 2 Receiver accepts an incoming PUBLISH Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must respond with PUBREC.
requirements.why_checkable: A QoS 2 PUBLISH can be sent and the response packet type observed.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBREC containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message.
requirements.condition: When PUBREC acknowledges an incoming QoS 2 PUBLISH Packet
requirements.required_behavior: PUBREC must contain the Packet Identifier from that PUBLISH Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The PUBLISH and PUBREC Packet Identifiers can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote: MUST respond with a PUBREC containing the Packet Identifier from the incoming PUBLISH Packet, having accepted ownership of the Application Message.
requirements.condition: Before the QoS 2 Receiver sends PUBREC
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must have accepted ownership of the Application Message.
requirements.why_checkable: Receiver state can be instrumented at PUBREC emission to confirm ownership has been accepted.

requirements.quote: Until it has received the corresponding PUBREL packet, the Receiver MUST acknowledge any subsequent PUBLISH packet with the same Packet Identifier by sending a PUBREC.
requirements.condition: Before corresponding PUBREL is received, when another PUBLISH arrives with the same Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must acknowledge the subsequent PUBLISH by sending PUBREC again.
requirements.why_checkable: A duplicate PUBLISH can be injected before PUBREL and the repeated PUBREC observed.

requirements.quote: It MUST NOT cause duplicate messages to be delivered to any onward recipients in this case.
requirements.condition: When a subsequent PUBLISH with the same Packet Identifier arrives before corresponding PUBREL
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must preserve a single onward delivery for that Application Message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Receiver must not cause duplicate delivery to any onward recipient.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated PUBLISH packets can be injected and all onward recipients monitored for duplicate deliveries.

requirements.quote: MUST respond to a PUBREL packet by sending a PUBCOMP packet containing the same Packet Identifier as the PUBREL.
requirements.condition: When the QoS 2 Receiver receives PUBREL
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must respond with PUBCOMP.
requirements.why_checkable: A PUBREL can be sent and the response packet type observed.

requirements.quote: MUST respond to a PUBREL packet by sending a PUBCOMP packet containing the same Packet Identifier as the PUBREL.
requirements.condition: When PUBCOMP acknowledges a PUBREL Packet
requirements.required_behavior: PUBCOMP must contain the same Packet Identifier as PUBREL.
requirements.why_checkable: The PUBREL and PUBCOMP Packet Identifiers can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote: After it has sent a PUBCOMP, the receiver MUST treat any subsequent PUBLISH packet that contains that Packet Identifier as being a new publication.
requirements.condition: After the Receiver sends PUBCOMP, when a later PUBLISH uses that Packet Identifier
requirements.required_behavior: The Receiver must treat the later PUBLISH as a new publication.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Receiver must not associate it with the completed QoS 2 exchange solely because the identifier is reused.
requirements.why_checkable: A Packet Identifier can be reused after PUBCOMP and the receiver's new-delivery behavior observed.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0 and has an unacknowledged PUBLISH Packet with QoS greater than 0
requirements.required_behavior: The Client must re-send that PUBLISH Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Client state can contain an unacknowledged QoS 1 or 2 PUBLISH before reconnection, and retransmission can be observed.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0 and the Server has an unacknowledged PUBLISH Packet with QoS greater than 0 for that Session
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must re-send that PUBLISH Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Server state can contain an unacknowledged QoS 1 or 2 PUBLISH before reconnection, and retransmission can be observed.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0 and has an unacknowledged PUBREL Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Client must re-send that PUBREL Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Client state can contain an unacknowledged PUBREL before reconnection, and retransmission can be observed.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0 and the Server has an unacknowledged PUBREL Packet for that Session
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must re-send that PUBREL Packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Server state can contain an unacknowledged PUBREL before reconnection, and retransmission can be observed.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When the Client re-sends an unacknowledged QoS>0 PUBLISH after CleanSession=0 reconnection
requirements.required_behavior: The re-sent PUBLISH must use its original Packet Identifier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Client must not allocate a new Packet Identifier for that replay.
requirements.why_checkable: The original and replayed Client PUBLISH identifiers can be compared.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When the Server re-sends an unacknowledged QoS>0 PUBLISH after CleanSession=0 reconnection
requirements.required_behavior: The re-sent PUBLISH must use its original Packet Identifier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not allocate a new Packet Identifier for that replay.
requirements.why_checkable: The original and replayed Server PUBLISH identifiers can be compared.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When the Client re-sends an unacknowledged PUBREL after CleanSession=0 reconnection
requirements.required_behavior: The re-sent PUBREL must use its original Packet Identifier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Client must not allocate a new Packet Identifier for that replay.
requirements.why_checkable: The original and replayed Client PUBREL identifiers can be compared.

requirements.quote: When a Client reconnects with CleanSession set to 0, both the Client and Server MUST re-send any unacknowledged PUBLISH Packets (where QoS > 0) and PUBREL Packets using their original Packet Identifiers [MQTT-4.4.0-1].
requirements.condition: When the Server re-sends an unacknowledged PUBREL after CleanSession=0 reconnection
requirements.required_behavior: The re-sent PUBREL must use its original Packet Identifier.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not allocate a new Packet Identifier for that replay.
requirements.why_checkable: The original and replayed Server PUBREL identifiers can be compared.

requirements.quote: This is the only circumstance where a Client or Server is REQUIRED to redeliver messages.
requirements.condition: Outside a Client reconnection with CleanSession set to 0
requirements.required_behavior: The protocol imposes no general requirement on a Client or Server to redeliver messages.
requirements.why_checkable: A compliance checker can scope mandatory redelivery findings to the stated reconnection transition without treating other contexts as required replay.
